Controls · Sopwith Camel
↑ / ↓
Pitch — nose up / nose down
← / →
Roll left / right
Q / E
Rudder left / right
Shift / Ctrl
Throttle up / down — 1–0 set it directly
Space
Fire (or hold the left mouse button) — short bursts: hot guns jam
B
Drop a bomb
T
Next target
C
Camera — chase, cockpit, target, orbit, cinematic, director, free
V
Hold to look at your target
M
Mouse as flight stick (press again to release)
F
Watch — the autopilot fights for you; any stick input takes it back
P / Esc
Pause
H
All shortcutsShow this help
World & view
O
Open / close the Style panel
Y
Time of day
R
Weather
N
New front — a fresh world (quick battle and watch)
Tab
Tactical map on / off
Alternative controls
W / S
Pitch, stick-style — push down / pull up
A / D
Same as left / right
Gamepad
Right stick flies, left stick throttle, triggers fire
Land at your own aerodrome and stop to refit: the ground crew patch the airframe, clear the guns and bring more ammunition. Use the World, Style and Controls tabs at the bottom of the screen to change the front, the weather and how the aircraft flies.
